001package org.clafer.common;
002
003/**
004 * The current system of constraints is unsatisfiable.
005 *
006 * @author jimmy
007 */
008public class UnsatisfiableException extends RuntimeException {
009
010    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
011
012    public UnsatisfiableException() {
013    }
014
015    public UnsatisfiableException(String message) {
016        super(message);
017    }
018
019    public UnsatisfiableException(String message, Throwable cause) {
020        super(message, cause);
021    }
022
023    public UnsatisfiableException(Throwable cause) {
024        super(cause);
025    }
026}
